snippet.title: Pokémon Pokopia – Nintendo Direct 9.12.2025
snippet.description:
Pokémon Pokopia releases March 5, 2026, on Nintendo Switch 2. Pre-order today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/pokemon-pokopia-switch-2/?utm_source=SW-AAA&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=S1020-01&utm_id=S1020-01

Play as a Ditto transformed into a human and shape an empty land into a beautiful home for Pokémon in Pokémon Pokopia, releasing on Nintendo Switch 2 in 2026.

#PokemonPokopia #NintendoSwitch2 #NintendoDirect

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
